svg.title: Connect Four: game 1, move 1
svg.desc: Game 1 of @tannergolden against GitHub, @tannergolden drops the White discs and GitHub the Black, after 1. 6, the Arbiter's move for @tannergolden: a white disc down column 6, to row 1. It is GitHub's turn as Black, due by 19 Oct. Column 6, from the foot: White.
